_comment: Single source of truth for the full8 submit_job fields and runner phase caps (jobs/full8/JOB_SPEC.md). Priced from the MEASURED job-5cmat phase timings (`measured` below; issue #68) plus the job-4j3vu stage-2 rate on layer 3. jobs/full8/preflight.py projects every phase, checks cap >= 1.3 x projection, the pipeline deadline and the stop floors; tests/test_full8.py checks the cost arithmetic and the schedule; jobs/full8/full8_job.sh reads the caps from here.

measured._comment: job-5cmat (probe9b one-layer, PR #73 @ 24f164e, exit 0, $5.01, 101 min), artifact art-2bybh sha256 dd491adea0601ddd9cb1121a471de9d44a8bfd39e232075d27f2f9af167fd409: out/pipeline/results.json (timing, stage1, progressive.steps[0], throughput), logs/run.log (phase wall times), out/index/rate_*.json and preflight.json. Its stage 2 converted layer 23 (the first layer in its KL order). The layer-3 stage-2 rate (the slowest any full-8 step can have: longest student suffix) is job-4j3vu's (art-5ys6j). S is the job's 101-min total minus the logged phases (S + final export).

estimates_not_measured._comment: X (write the 8-layer fp32 GDN file, ~2.16 GB, hash it, re-read it, strict-load every layer into the HF Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet on CPU) has no receipt; 3 min is an estimate (torch.save + 2 sha256 passes over 2.2 GB on local NVMe ~0.5 min, plus 8 CPU module builds).

mmlu_full._comment: Amendment A1: full MMLU test set per arm, volume computed exactly (local, CPU) with the pinned Qwen3.5 tokenizer (tokenizer.json sha256 5f9e4d49... = the 9B snapshot's, jobs/m2_pilot/q9af_snapshot.sha256) over cais/mmlu all/test @ c30699e8: prompt = probes.core._mmlu_prompt, right-padded to 128, batches of 16,384 positions.
